_readme: This file tracks all guides pending conversion from ScribeHow to local HTML. Each entry contains everything needed to re-integrate the converted guide into index.html. The 'outputFile' field shows where the converted HTML should be saved. Once converted, add the guide as an <a> tag in both the desktop and mobile-only list sections of index.html using the pattern in the development plan.
